name: Freestanding gas range
notes: Rig: oven-door hinge X -90...0 (part oven-door); drawer slide +Z 0...0.35; knob1-5 hinge Z 0...270 (knob1 left-rear, knob2 left-front, knob3 center, knob4 right-front, knob5 right-rear), oven knob 0...270. oven door with window and bar handle
oven cavity with two racks and bake element
style: mid-range 30 in gas range, light grease near knobs
summary: Freestanding 30 in gas range: cast-iron grates over five burners, knob row, windowed oven door and racks, storage drawer.
